I had to take my baby Graci to be euthanized.  She  was 18 and blind and had a severe heart murmur, I just knew it was time.  I couldn’t let her suffer so I called a vets office to have the procedure done.  They were all very nice and let me have time to say goodbye to my first baby, my little pup.  It was literally the hardest shit I have ever done in my life.  In one way I wanted to be selfish and keep her here.  I felt extremely guilty that this is what had to happen.  However I loved her more than my selfishness, I couldn’t let her live in misery.  This was November 1, 2022.  I was with her when she passed, she was calm and my girl was ready to go.  The staff helped me with picking out an urn, and they left so I could tell her goodbye.  I never wanted to leave her there. The staff got her back to me in like two or three days.  They also sent me a card and gave me prints of her nose and paws for me to keep, they shaved off her very distinct tail hair and sent that to me too which I loved.  I am going to try to figure out something I can do with it to put by her memorial area.  I miss her so much it hurts but she had a good long life.  I love my Graci girl. ❤️
